title: 第一卷 第5章 见一个扒一个第一卷 第6章 金刚符发威
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了

“臭道士，我要杀了你！”霸刀门首席此刻怒不可遏，对着柳东岳咆哮着，就像是一条疯狗一样。
“杀了他！”
“妈的，我要拿你祭刀！”
赵家的弟子们也都满脸恼怒的嘶吼着。
然而所有人都只是吼着，却是没有一个人上来，因为他们所有人这个时候全都蹲在地上，一只手捂着自己的屁股，另外一只手捂着自己的胯下。
根本腾不出手来去杀柳东岳。
感受着周围人的目光和尖叫声，他们恨不得找个地缝钻进去！
但是他们还不敢站起来。
“我……我也不知道是怎么回事，诸位，抱歉啊。”柳东岳此时也是尴尬至极，这特么是什么灵宝！
收人武器就算了，怎么还带收人家衣服的？
说完，柳东岳直接摆脱他们奔着百枯山的方向飞奔。
“王八蛋，你给我回来，你把衣服还给我！”
“等我出去一定宰了你！”
赵家和霸刀门的人都在大声的咆哮着。
周围的人也都憋着笑，继续他们的争斗，没有人理会霸刀门和赵家人，他们注定是要被淘汰了。
然而此刻在太玄圣地的广场上，霸刀门和赵家的高层此时已经满脸羞红！
他们的弟子竟然被人连衣服都扒了。
两家弟子赤身裸体的在风沙谷聚成一堆，白花花的肉，几千人就从他们身边走过，在他们身边战斗，好像在参观一样，这样的场景简直辣眼睛。
“哈哈哈，你们霸刀门的弟子挺白啊！”

“赵家的那个赵贤，小屁股还挺翘啊，哈哈！”
周围嗤笑的声音让两家的高层恨不得现在转身就走。
但是他们走了，他们的弟子怎么办呢？
就连太玄圣地的几个长老也是感觉有点尴尬，赶紧将镜花水月的镜头给转到别的地方。
“那个小道士是长生观的弟子吧？他的七宝葫芦好奇怪，怎么还会将人的衣服给收走呢？”一名长老嘀嘀咕咕的说着。
其他人也是深以为然，他们也想不通。
以前也没听说过有这样的灵宝啊。
但是他们也并没有在意，毕竟这样的考核对他们来说无异于小辈们的打打闹闹，根本无法引起他们的注意，况且这次考核本就是给他们太玄圣地的弟子铺路罢了。
此时柳东岳一路狂奔，凭借着高深的轻功，柳东岳发现此时在他前面的人竟然不多了。
“莫非我有希望争一争那五千两银子？”柳东岳脸色一喜。
前百名可是有五千两银子的奖励的。
到时候拿出八百两给李寒舟还了赌债，剩下的自己留起来，留着修炼，再给师弟师妹买几身衣服，留着生活。
想到这里，柳东岳更有动力了。
“哪里来的道士，好轻功！”这个时候，一道雷霆一般的声音炸响，紧接着一个身影拦住了柳东岳的去路。
来人气息强横，腰间一把弯刀，尤为锋利。
“岳山宗申宗傲！”
看到来人的装扮，柳东岳心中一沉。
对方的气息看上去像是七品修为，自己根本不是对手。
“没落的道门弟子竟然能追逐到前三十名来，也是有点本事，但是前面的名额不是你个小小的五品武者跑的快就能拿到的。”申宗傲缓缓的说。
“拼了！”

"Stinky Taoist, I'm going to kill you!" The chief of Ba Dao Sect was furious at this moment, roaring at Liu Dongyue like a mad dog.
"Kill him!"
"Damn it, I'm going to use your sacrificial knife!"
The disciples of the Zhao family also roared with anger on their faces.
However, everyone just roared, but no one came up, because all of them were squatting on the ground at this time, covering their buttocks with one hand, and covering their crotch with the other hand.
There was simply no way to kill Liu Dongyue.
Feeling the gazes and screams of the people around them, they wanted to find a crack in the ground and crawl in!
But they didn't dare to stand up yet.
"I...I don't know what's going on. Everyone, I'm sorry." Liu Dongyue was also extremely embarrassed at this time. What kind of spiritual treasure is this!
Forget about taking away weapons, why are you taking away people’s clothes?
After saying that, Liu Dongyue got rid of them and ran in the direction of Baiku Mountain.
"You bastard, come back here and give me your clothes!"
"I will kill you when I get out!"
People from the Zhao family and Ba Dao Clan were roaring loudly.
The people around them also suppressed their laughter and continued their fight. No one paid attention to the Ba Daomen and the Zhao family. They were destined to be eliminated.
However, in the square of Taixuan Holy Land at this moment, the senior officials of Ba Daomen and Zhao family were blushing with embarrassment!
Their disciple was even stripped of his clothes.
Disciples from the two families gathered naked in a pile in the Windsand Valley, with their flesh covered in white. Thousands of people walked past them and fought beside them, as if they were visiting. This scene was simply eye-catching.
"Hahaha, your disciples from the Ba Dao Sect are quite fair!"
"Zhao Xian from the Zhao family has a pretty little butt, haha!"
The sneers around them made the top executives of the two families want to turn around and leave now.
But when they leave, what will happen to their disciples?
Even the elders of Taixuan Holy Land felt a little embarrassed and quickly turned the lens of Mirror Flowers and Water Moon to other places.
"Is that little Taoist a disciple of the Temple of Immortality? His seven-treasure gourd is so strange. Why does it take away people's clothes?" an elder muttered.
Others also believed it, and they couldn't figure it out either.
I have never heard of such a spiritual treasure before.
But they didn't care. After all, to them, such an assessment was nothing more than a fight among the juniors and could not attract their attention at all. Besides, this assessment was just to pave the way for their disciples in the Taixuan Holy Land.
At this time, Liu Dongyue ran all the way. Relying on his advanced Qinggong, Liu Dongyue found that there were not many people in front of him at this time.
"Is there any hope that I can compete for the five thousand taels of silver?" Liu Dongyue's face was filled with joy.
The top 100 will be rewarded with five thousand taels of silver.
When the time comes, he will give Li Hanzhou 800 taels to pay off his gambling debt, and keep the rest for his cultivation, and then buy some clothes for his junior brothers and sisters to live on.
Thinking of this, Liu Dongyue became more motivated.
"Where did the Taoist priest come from? What a light kung fu!" At this time, a thunderous voice exploded, and then a figure blocked Liu Dongyue's path.
The person coming had a strong aura and a scimitar at his waist, which was particularly sharp.
"Yueshan Zongshen Zongao!"
Liu Dongyue's heart sank when he saw the visitor's attire.
The other party's aura looked like someone with a seventh-grade cultivation level, and he was no match at all.
"The declining Taoist disciples can actually chase the top thirty, which is quite capable, but the places in front are not something that you, a little fifth-level warrior, can get by running fast." Shen Zongao said slowly.
"Fight!"
